sign: A town on rafts. Where it stands tomorrow depends on the bog and on who paid Corran.
North: Candle Causeway. West: Hymnmarsh. East: the Heaving Fields. South: the Raft Rift. The Raft Market: the tarred door.

lines: Raft Nurse Odile: Sleep on deck. If you wake up somewhere new, that's normal. If you wake up in the water, that's Corran.
Ropewright Jory: Tonics, tar and rope. Buy rope. Everyone here ends up needing rope or being tied with it.

lines: Pole Boy Kit: I push the rafts apart at dawn so the neighbours don't fight. Then I sell them each other's addresses.
Widow Rowena: My husband sold the morning position to two buyers. Driftwick split in half that night. So did he.
Skipper Hale: Sixty years afloat and I've never seen the same sunrise twice. Some of them I've seen from underneath.
